def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    df['species'] = df['species'].replace({'Gentto': 'Gentoo', 'Adeile': 'Adelie'})
    df['island'] = df['island'].str.strip().str.capitalize()
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] = df.loc[df['body_mass_g'] > 6500, 'body_mass_g'] / 1000
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(float)
    df['year'] = df['year'].astype(float)
    return df

def answer(df):
    return df.groupby('sex')['body_mass_g'].mean().to_dict()
